subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI chat can stay stuck busy and stop flushing queued messages after a long run

question: Should maintainers refresh and prove the existing recovery PR, close it and keep this issue for a cleaner current-main fix, or explicitly waive the proof gate?
rationale: The issue remains valid by source inspection, but automation should not open another fix while an open same-repo closing PR already owns the candidate path and is blocked on merge state plus real behavior proof.

options.title: Refresh and prove the existing PR
options.body: Port or refresh the watchdog recovery onto the current split chat modules and attach redacted Control UI browser/gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Close the stale PR and keep the issue
options.body: If the existing branch is not worth saving, close it and leave this issue open as the canonical current-main fix target.

options.title: Waive proof explicitly
options.body: A maintainer can accept the session/message-delivery risk without live proof after reviewing the source and tests.

recommendation.title: Refresh and prove the existing PR
recommendation.body: Port or refresh the watchdog recovery onto the current split chat modules and attach redacted Control UI browser/gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main routing owner from blame on the split chat modules and latest release comparison.
